correctness.rationale: For F0=0,F1=1 and legal index pairs 2≤i<j≤N,j-i≥2, two-summand Niven iff F_i+F_j even. Exact doubling identities yield v2(F_(n+6*2^k)-F_n)=k+2 (3∤n), k+3 (n=0 mod6), k+4 (n=3 mod6). Bit-flip shifts prove the modular period P_a=3*2^(a-1) and fixed C_a(x)=c(x mod32) where c=3 for x=1 mod4,1 for x=3 mod4,2 for x=0 mod8,8 for x=2 mod32,0 otherwise. Independent integer enumeration confirms a=5..10 (2016 residue cells), exact 32-class convolution and normalization. The pair-convolution leading coefficient is κ(r mod32)/(18*2^a) N² for even r, with table κ=(8,14,14,10,8,14,6,10,8,14,6,10,8,14,6,10); odd r zero, O_a(N) boundary. All-a assertion uses the valuation and lifting induction, not finite testing.
residual_risks: Finite experiments and exact checks do not alone establish infinite/uniform quantifiers; proof reconstructed from original RESULT.md.
